pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   C. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   B. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   D. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hijra to Madina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Constitution of Madina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on good Behaviour and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
